title: Ohio county poverty and near-poverty ratios
description: Complete consistent five-year county directory. State and counties overlap; do not add the Ohio row to its counties.
methodology: Exact retained Census source counts. Ratios are derived from unrounded counts and rounded to one decimal. Component margins of error remain published values. Derived sums/rates have blank MOEs; no significance or causal claim is inferred.

source.title: Census 2024 five-year C17002 via Census Reporter
source.locator: Ohio and all 88 counties / C17002 cells 001–008
source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau; structured data served by Census Reporter

columns.label: County FIPS
columns.definition: Three-digit Ohio county FIPS; blank for state

columns.label: Population in poverty universe
columns.definition: Population for whom poverty status is determined

columns.label: Population MOE
columns.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error; blank when not provided by this original source.

columns.label: Income below poverty threshold
columns.definition: Sum of disjoint source bins below income-to-poverty ratio 1.00.

columns.label: Below poverty (%)
columns.definition: 100 times below100 divided by population, rounded to one decimal.

columns.label: Below-poverty derived MOE
columns.definition: Blank: no derived sum MOE is represented as an original published value.

columns.label: Income below twice poverty threshold
columns.definition: Sum of disjoint bins below ratio 2.00. Includes people below the poverty threshold.

columns.label: Below twice poverty (%)
columns.definition: 100 times below200 divided by population, rounded to one decimal.

columns.label: Below-twice-poverty derived MOE
columns.definition: Blank: component uncertainty is retained in the original source.
